results.title: Pinterest Inc. (via Public) / Quarterly Report for Quarter Ending September 30, 2026 (Form 10-Q)
highlights:
Overview of Third Quarter Results 

 Our key financial and operating results as of and for the three months ended September 30, 2026, unless noted otherwise, are as follows: 

 • Revenue was $1,173.9 million, an increase of 12% on a reported and constant currency basis compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025. 

 • Monthly active users ("MAUs") were 661 million, an increase of 10% compared to September 30, 2025. 

 • Share-based compensation expense was $291.7 million, an increase of $56.6 million compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025. 

 • Income from operations was $30.3 million, a decrease of $28.2 million compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025. 

 • Net income was $21.5 million and Adjusted EBITDA was $339.2 million. 

 • Net cash provided by operating activities was $936.6 million and free cash flow was $881.9 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2026. 

 • Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities was $1,470.0 million. 

 • Headcount was 5,192.

...

In January 2026, we initiated a global restructuring plan (the "Restructuring Plan") to support our transformation initiatives, including but not limited to (i) reallocating resources to AI-focused roles and teams that drive AI adoption and execution, (ii) prioritizing AI-powered products and capabilities, and (iii) accelerating the transformation of our sales and go-to-market approach. As part of the Restructuring Plan, we commenced a workforce reduction of less than 15% as well as office space reductions. The Restructuring Plan was completed during the third quarter of 2026.

results.title: Pinterest, Inc.: what AI can do in its workforce, from its annual report | Stratus Workforce Scan
highlights:
# Pinterest, Inc. (PINS)

Visual discovery platform, 5,265 full-time employees. Read October 20, 2026 from the annual report for the period ending December 31, 2025, filed February 12, 2026. Ranked 17 of the 51 Communication Services companies read so far, by the share within reach now.

...

The filing states 5,265 full-time employees of one advertising-funded platform with nothing by function or country, so one social network pattern carries the workforce.

The figures on this page come from the company's own annual report and from BLS staffing patterns for its industries, never from a roster. They are estimates with a stated method. Nothing here says what the company will do: within reach is not a forecast of jobs lost or of savings.

...

## Headcount

5,265 employees as of December 31, 2025 (stated). The filing counts no employees by country; the data service's table is revenue by region.

The filing: “As of December 31, 2025, we had 5,265 full-time employees.”

...
